verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the REST and GraphQL Management APIs can manage products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically. API access uses scoped store, app, or account OAuth credentials and comes with a Request Runner, API clients and webhooks. That covers the product-creation and order-management halves of the story, but nothing in the pack mentions issuing refunds or triggering fulfillments or shipments through the API. A community report of API throttling and dropped connections lowers confidence but does not contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: documented refund API, documented fulfillment/shipment API, explicit order-edit endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of lifecycle automation.
